tasks.title: Implement Variable Attack Countdown System
tasks.description: Redesign combat to use turn-based with variable attack countdowns instead of fixed rounds. Each unit has an attack speed stat that determines countdown timer. Actions resolve in countdown completion order (asynchronous turn order).
tasks.details:
- Replace fixed round system with countdown-based action queue
- Attack speed stat determines countdown duration
- Implement countdown tracker for each unit and ability
- Support multiple active attacks per character with independent counters
- Ensure backwards compatibility with existing combat logic
- Add tests for countdown calculation and action ordering

subtasks.title: Design Countdown Data Structures
subtasks.description: Define TypeScript interfaces and types for the countdown system. Create data structures to track countdown state for units and abilities.
subtasks.details:
- Create CountdownTracker interface for units
- Define AbilityCountdown type
- Create ActionQueue interface
- Define AttackSpeed stat integration
- Create types for countdown resolution order
- Document countdown calculation formula

subtasks.title: Implement Countdown Calculation Logic
subtasks.description: Create the core countdown calculation system that determines when units act based on attack speed stats.
subtasks.details:
- Implement countdown calculation from attack speed
- Create countdown decrement/tick system
- Implement action queue ordering by countdown
- Handle multiple abilities per unit
- Test countdown edge cases (speed 0, very high speed)
- Ensure fair turn ordering with ties

subtasks.title: Replace Fixed Round System
subtasks.description: Refactor existing combat loop to use countdown-based action queue instead of fixed rounds.
subtasks.details:
- Update combat state management
- Replace round counter with countdown tracker
- Modify combat loop to process by countdown
- Update combat phase logic
- Test compatibility with existing combat features
- Ensure no regression in damage/ability resolution

subtasks.title: Support Multiple Active Attacks Per Character
subtasks.description: Implement system for characters to have multiple attacks with independent countdown timers.
subtasks.details:
- Define multi-attack data structure
- Create independent countdown tracking for each attack
- Implement attack selection/rotation logic
- Handle attack conflicts (same unit, multiple attacks)
- Test multi-attack scenarios in combat
- Balance multi-attack units fairly

subtasks.title: Backwards Compatibility Testing
subtasks.description: Verify countdown system doesn't break existing combat mechanics and features.
subtasks.details:
- Test existing unit abilities with countdown
- Verify damage calculations work correctly
- Test passive abilities trigger properly
- Ensure targeting system still works
- Test death detection and end conditions
- Run full combat sequences

subtasks.title: Add Unit Tests for Countdown System
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive unit tests for countdown calculation and action ordering logic.
subtasks.details:
- Test countdown calculation accuracy
- Test action queue ordering
- Test edge cases (speed 0, max speed)
- Test multi-ability countdown independence
- Test countdown reset after actions
- Test action ordering consistency
- Achieve >90% code coverage

tasks.title: Add Visual Countdown Displays
tasks.description: Create clear visual displays of attack countdowns so players can anticipate upcoming actions. Display countdown progress for each unit's next attack.
tasks.details:
- Add countdown UI components for each unit
- Show remaining turns/actions until next attack
- Visual indicators (progress bars, numbers, animations)
- Highlight when unit is about to act
- Ensure clarity during rapid action sequences
- Test with varying combat speeds

tasks.title: Implement Genetic Weaknesses System
tasks.description: Add heritable genetic 'weaknesses' that provide drawbacks as strategic tradeoffs. Weaknesses should be passed down to offspring and create interesting team-building decisions.
tasks.details:
- Define weakness types (reduced damage, slower speed, fragility, etc.)
- Implement inheritance mechanics for weaknesses across generations
- Balance drawbacks with potential stat benefits
- Display weakness information in UI
- Create 3-5 initial weakness types for testing
- Test inheritance in Lab breeding system

tasks.title: Implement Mid-Run Perk/Talent System
tasks.description: Add perk/talent choices at new levels during runs to differentiate monsters in-run. Players should get meaningful choices that affect combat strategy.
tasks.details:
- Create perk/talent selection UI shown on level up
- Design 10-15 initial perks (stat boosts, new abilities, passive modifiers)
- Implement perk application to units
- Display active perks in unit info
- Balance perks to create meaningful choices
- Ensure perks don't break game balance
- Test perk interactions with existing abilities

tasks.title: Implement Joker-Style Item Modifiers
tasks.description: Create "Joker" style modifiers that apply global bonuses to specific attack or ability types. These should provide powerful run-altering effects.
tasks.details:
- Define joker item structure (ability type, bonus effect, rarity)
- Implement 5-10 initial joker items for testing
- Create mechanics for applying global bonuses
- Ensure jokers affect all applicable attacks in the run
- Balance joker power to avoid breaking strategy
- Display active jokers in run info
- Test joker interactions with hybrid creatures

tasks.title: Implement Limited Shop Stock System
tasks.description: Redesign shop to have limited stock instead of infinite purchases. Create scarcity-based strategic choices for item purchasing.
tasks.details:
- Add stock counter to each shop item
- Limit health potions, jokers, and other items per shop
- Randomize available items and quantities per run
- Ensure items run out when stock reaches 0
- Update shop UI to show stock levels
- Test with various stock configurations
- Balance availability to avoid extreme scarcity

tasks.title: Implement Variable Reward System Based on Enemy Level
tasks.description: Make coin rewards scale with enemy level and difficulty. Add bonus achievement rewards for combat performance.
tasks.details:
- Calculate coin rewards based on enemy level/difficulty
- Implement achievement system (flawless victory, quick kill, etc.)
- Add bonus coins for achievement completion
- Display earned coins and achievements after combat
- Test reward scaling across enemy levels
- Balance rewards to incentivize interesting play
- Create 5-8 initial achievements

tasks.title: Implement Hybrid Creature Combinations
tasks.description: Create hybrid creature combinations that merge two species into mythical creatures with unique abilities. Examples: Tiger+Eagle=Gryphon, Lizard+Bird=Dragon.
tasks.details:
- Define 3-5 hybrid combinations with mechanics
- Create unique attack types (fire breath, laser eyes, etc.)
- Implement hybrid stats calculation (blend of parents)
- Add hybrid visuals/naming in UI
- Create hybrid-specific perks/talents
- Implement hybrid breeding in Lab
- Test hybrid viability in combat
- Ensure hybrids feel unique and powerful

tasks.title: Integrate New Species Abilities Transfer System
tasks.description: Allow new species to unlock unique abilities and traits that can be copied/edited/cloned into other units. Create ability inheritance mechanics for run-long progression.
tasks.details:
- Design ability transfer rules and limitations
- Implement gene editing UI in Lab
- Allow copying abilities between compatible units
- Create mutation mechanics for transferred abilities
- Display transferable abilities in unit info
- Test transfer chains (A→B→C)
- Balance transfer power to maintain challenge
- Create documentation for ability transfer system

tasks.title: Combat Redesign Testing & Balance
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing and balance pass on all new combat features. Ensure combat is engaging without real-time reflexes required.
tasks.details:
- Test variable countdown against fixed round system
- Verify countdown math is correct and fair
- Test action ordering edge cases
- Balance attack speeds to create varied pacing
- Verify inheritance systems don't create exploits
- Test all perk/weakness/joker interactions
- Playtest multiple full runs
- Gather feedback on combat pacing and engagement
- Make balance adjustments based on testing

tasks.title: Integration Testing: Evolution + Combat Systems
tasks.description: Verify that evolution system (breeding, genetic traits, stat growth) deeply integrates with combat mechanics. Ensure team composition decisions matter.
tasks.details:
- Test that stat grades affect combat viability
- Verify weakness inheritance impacts strategy
- Test hybrid creature viability in combat
- Ensure perk choices create meaningful team differences
- Verify item choices interact well with unit stats
- Test multi-generational breeding effects
- Ensure no dominant strategies emerge
- Balance felt by players in playtests

metadata.description: Phase 4: V1.1 Combat Redesign - Enhanced combat with variable countdowns, evolution integration, joker items, and hybrid creatures
